notes:
What's new in 0.1.120:
- Watching in the browser: if Chrome cannot show the film's own picture, the player now says so in words instead of a black screen, and Original playback recovers by itself after a seek that got stuck. The speaker panel stays inside a wide, short window, and podcast and audiobook search hints are no longer cut off.
- Watch Together and Movie Night: the host's Pause is no longer undone while guests get ready, a room join is refused if the room changed after it was approved, an open window is reused, and Movie Night refusals read in plain words in every language. The TV and guests keep their room through a short connection problem.
- Photos, Home and music: the photo viewer's arrow keys work on videos and focus stays inside the open photo, month albums are named with month and year, and a failed photo preview recovers. You can pin a collection as a Home row, and each profile can choose how music artists are shown and hide artists.
- Sign-in and updates: the photos, school and Easy Mode web pages tie their access pass to the sign-in that made it, a session with a time cap ends exactly at the cap, and the updater now checks that the installer is the one the update feed named and no longer installs a revoked update automatically.
- Live TV and requests: recording rules follow their current owner, revoked private feeds are retired, series with accented or non-Latin titles match, and a request for the same title under another name or year is recognised.
- Smaller fixes: the notification table no longer cuts off its Webhook column, Wake-on-LAN information prefers real network cards, and more screens are translated.
- Automated tests and code review only; this build has not been installed on a PC or tried on a TV, phone or Jellyfin app by a person yet. 0.1.119 was published on November 11, 2026.
- Release source commit bcfa6a97b.
